title: On the Evaluation Practices in Multilingual NLP: Can Machine Translation Offer an Alternative to Human Translations?

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the zero-shot performance of multilingual language models across 198 languages categorized by resource availability (high, mid, low, and unseen) using machine-translated NLU benchmarks (XNLI, PAWS-X, XCOPA, and XStorycloze) to identify performance disparities and assess whether models overestimate capabilities on low-resource and unseen languages.
